messages:
maia: seeing p99 token latency spike in east-west inference path, started ~09:42 UTC. dashboards show packet loss on host-to-host flows between gpufarm-12[.x] -> gpufarm-13. can someone with tc foo look?
ethan: on it. is this just one AZ or region-wide?
maia: looks isolated to us-east-2a GPU pool. other regions fine.
sre-bot: ALERT: inference-p99 > 1.2s for service 'redwood-gen' in region us-east-2a. triggered at 2024-10-11T09:42:10Z.
ethan: grabbing a node. running `ssh gpufarm-12-3` then `sudo tc qdisc show dev eth0`
maia: attaching output below — noticed fq_codel on root qdisc which is odd for our GPU hosts (we usually run noqueue on Mellanox RDMA interfaces):
```
maia: sudo tc qdisc show dev eth0
qdisc fq_codel 1: root refcnt 2 limit 10240 backlog 0b
qdisc pfifo_fast 0:1 parent 1:1 bands 3 priomap  ...
```
ethan: that explains micro-bursts getting dropped, RDMA ignores veth config but kernel-level egress shaping can still interfere. do you have `ip link` mtu?
maia: `ip link show eth0` -> mtu 9000 (unchanged). the fq_codel was applied by automation `qos-scaler` earlier this morning (I can see a run id 20241011-03:10 in the ops history).
lia: confirmed: `qos-scaler` job targeted a label selector and accidentally matched a subset of GPU hosts due to new nodepool label `env:gpu-economy`. rollout note: commit 9f2b added a generic egress-shaper template.
ops-lead: ok rollback plan: remove fq_codel from affected hosts and set qdisc to noqueue for RDMA NICs. commands:
```
ops-lead: sudo tc qdisc del dev eth0 root
ops-lead: sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root noqueue
```
ops-lead: also pin the automation to exclude nodepool label `gpu-*` until we fix selector. lia can you patch the job? @lia
lia: patching now. updating selector to `node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu=true` and adding explicit `exclude: gpu-pool-economy`. will push in 2m.
ethan: running the del/add on gpufarm-12-3 now...
ethan: done on node, running perf tests: initial p50/p95 improved, p99 still slightly high — checking other nodes in that AZ.
maia: confirmed we had fq_codel on 5 hosts in the pool. removed from all 5. running small gen load, p99 dropped back within SLO at 09:48 UTC.
sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p99 recovered for 'redwood-gen' in us-east-2a at 2024-10-11T09:48:12Z.
lia: follow-up actions: 1) add explicit RDMA-aware qdisc guard in qos-scaler (do not apply to interfaces with MTU >= 9000 / or label `rdma=true`), 2) add canary selector and dry-run by default, 3) postmortem with timeline. I'll create a ticket.
ops-lead: good. cost note: this was caused by an optimization attempt to reduce egress tail latency for small VMs; we need a safety check in PRs affecting node labels.
maia: thanks all. one ask: can infra add a dashboard showing qdisc changes per node (simple event log) so we catch this faster?
lia: yes will add that to infra backlog, tagging @ops-lead for prioritization. :thumbsup:
